notes.title: TargetPOP v1.2
notes.notes:
-Fixed visual bug with Playing Card theme on ultrawide displays
-Updated Basics Menu to display more information
-Redesigned Time Boost to avoid blockage of the grid
-Added new menu after each game, Round Results, which now displays all missed targets, normal targets popped, gold targets popped, and total score
-Rebalanced main gameplay to slightly reduce difficulty of reaching 999 points
-Added mouse click support as an alternative to the space bar

notes.title: TargetPOP v1.1.1
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug with petting the dog
-Slightly reduced disk size

notes.title: TargetPOP v1.1
notes.notes:
-Fixed issue with intro screen on Linux and Steam Deck for REAL this time.
-Made changes to intro screen on all platforms, should not affect gameplay.
-Added a cute little dog to the title screen to celebrate this victory
-Yes, you can pet it... and toggle it off if you want to :(

notes.title: TargetPOP Version 1.0.2
notes.notes: -Fixed issue with intro screen display on Linux build

notes.title: TargetPOP Linux Error
notes.notes: The Linux Build of TargetPOP, as well as the Steam Deck, both seem to be unable to open the application due to the intro screen. The intro screen has been temporarily disabled for Linux builds in order for the application to remain playable. This will be fixed at a later date.

notes.title: TargetPOP Version 1.0.1

TargetPOP Version 1.0.1 Patch Notes:

-Added support for MacOS and Linux
-Fixed bug with display on ultrawide monitors
